name: 60-parallel-overlap
prompt: Make three changes to pkg/registry.go. Delegate each one to its own editing subagent (the task tool with edit: true), starting all three in the same step so they run in parallel, then make sure the combined result builds and `go test ./...` passes. 1) Put trims surrounding whitespace from the name before storing it, and rejects a name that is empty after trimming. 2) Names are case-insensitive: Put and Get both fold the name to lower case. 3) Names returns the names sorted.
